(Nasdaq: IMUX), today announced that from November 9, 2026 to November 23, 2026, the Compensation Committee of Immunic's Board of Directors granted inducement equity grants covering an aggregate of 359,250 shares of common stock of the company under the Immunic, Inc. 2026 Inducement Equity Compensation Plan (the “Options”) to eight new employees.
